authority: CEO R320 §7 — DECISION_CONSEQUENCE for all experiment-required packages

P-02.experiment: Bench: adaptive vs fixed valve in mock CSF loop
P-02.PASS: Adaptive ICP excursion < 60% of fixed → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → pre-clinical
P-02.FAIL: Adaptive ICP excursion >= 60% of fixed → REPAIR (redesign valve profile) → if fails again CEMETERY
P-02.AMBIGUOUS: 20-60% reduction → repeat with larger sample (20 runs each) for statistical power

P-04.experiment: In vitro: NEP-coated catheter in Aβ-spiked aCSF, 72h
P-04.PASS: NEP clears >= 80% Aβ42 → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → animal model
P-04.FAIL: NEP clears < 50% → REPAIR (increase enzyme loading or switch to BACE2) → if fails CEMETERY
P-04.AMBIGUOUS: 50-80% clearance → test enzyme stability (is it deactivating?) → repeat with fresh enzyme

P-07.experiment: Bench: obstruction simulation with/without safety floor
P-07.PASS: Safety floor maintains drainage > 0.1 mL/min during 70% obstruction → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE
P-07.FAIL: Safety floor drainage < 0.05 mL/min → REPAIR (increase floor diameter) → if fails CEMETERY
P-07.AMBIGUOUS: 0.05-0.1 mL/min → test with different obstruction geometries

P-09.PASS: Molecule with demonstrated ICP-dependent release → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE
P-09.FAIL: No molecule found after 12 months → CEMETERY (CSF chemistry constraint)
P-09.AMBIGUOUS: Partial response → extend search or partner with pharma

P-11.experiment: In vitro: phage-coated catheter in S. aureus biofilm assay, 7 days
P-11.PASS: Phage-coated biofilm < 20% of control → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → animal model
P-11.FAIL: Biofilm >= 50% of control → REPAIR (phage cocktail instead of single phage) → if fails CEMETERY
P-11.AMBIGUOUS: 20-50% reduction → test phage stability (is it deactivating in CSF?) → repeat with stabilizer

P-12.experiment: In vitro: Cathepsin D-coated catheter in tau-spiked aCSF, 72h
P-12.PASS: Enzyme clears >= 80% tau → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → animal model
P-12.FAIL: Clears < 50% → REPAIR (increase loading or switch to IDE enzyme) → if fails CEMETERY
P-12.AMBIGUOUS: 50-80% → test enzyme kinetics in CSF (is substrate limiting?) → repeat with higher tau concentration

P-13.experiment: Retrospective: train predictor on shunt patient data, test on held-out cohort
P-13.PASS: AUC >= 0.80, lead time >= 12h → TECHNICALLY_EVALUABLE → prospective clinical study
P-13.FAIL: AUC < 0.70 → REPAIR (add features or switch to multimodal model) → if fails CEMETERY
P-13.AMBIGUOUS: AUC 0.70-0.80 → collect more training data or test on external cohort
